name: zoom
label: Zoom
description: Video conferencing, web conferencing, webinars, screen sharing

zoom_create_meeting.label: Create Zoom Meeting

start_time.label: Start Time
start_time.description: Meeting start date-time, for example 2026-11-01T15:00:00 (read in the Timezone below) or 2026-11-01T15:00:00Z (UTC).

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone for the start time, for example America/New_York. Defaults to UTC.

password.label: Password
password.description: The password required to join the meeting. By default, a password can only have a maximum length of 10 characters and only contain alphanumeric characters and the @, -, _, and * characters.

pre_schedule.label: Pre Schedule
pre_schedule.description: Whether the prescheduled meeting was created via the GSuite app.

schedule_for.label: Schedule for
schedule_for.description: The email address or user ID of the user to schedule a meeting for.

join_url.label: Join URL
join_url.description: Not used by Zoom (kept for compatibility). Zoom creates the join URL and returns it in the output.

require_authentication.label: Require Zoom Sign-in to Join
require_authentication.description: When on, only participants signed in to a Zoom account can join. Turn off to let anyone with the link join.

zoom_create_meeting_registrant.label: Create Zoom Meeting Registrant
zoom_create_meeting_registrant.description: Create and submit a user's registration to a meeting.

zip.label: Zip
zip.description: The registrant's zip or postal code.

custom_questions.label: Custom questions
custom_questions.description: Answers to the meeting's custom registration questions: use the question title as the key and the answer as the value.

role_in_purchase_process.label: Role in purchase process
role_in_purchase_process.description: The registrant's role in the purchase process.

zoom_get_meeting.label: Get Meeting
zoom_get_meeting.description: Get the details of a meeting by its meeting ID.

meeting_id.label: Meeting ID
meeting_id.description: The numeric Zoom meeting ID, for example 85746065432.

occurrence_id.label: Occurrence ID
occurrence_id.description: Only for recurring meetings: the occurrence ID of one specific occurrence. Leave empty to target the whole meeting.

show_previous_occurrences.label: Show Previous Occurrences
show_previous_occurrences.description: For recurring meetings: also include occurrences that already happened.

zoom_update_meeting_by_id.label: Update Meeting (by ID)
zoom_update_meeting_by_id.description: Change a meeting by its meeting ID. Only the fields you fill in are changed.

meeting_id.label: Meeting ID
meeting_id.description: The numeric Zoom meeting ID to change, for example 85746065432.

occurrence_id.label: Occurrence ID
occurrence_id.description: Only for recurring meetings: the occurrence ID of one specific occurrence. Leave empty to target the whole meeting.

start_time.label: Start Time
start_time.description: New start date-time, for example 2026-11-01T15:00:00 (read in the meeting timezone) or 2026-11-01T15:00:00Z (UTC).

clear_agenda.label: Clear Agenda
clear_agenda.description: Turn on to remove the current agenda. Ignored when Agenda is filled in.

password.label: Passcode
password.description: New passcode: up to 10 characters, letters, numbers and @ - _ * only.

host_video.label: Host Video
host_video.description: Start video when the host joins. Leave unchanged to keep the meeting's current setting.

participant_video.label: Participant Video
participant_video.description: Start video when participants join. Leave unchanged to keep the meeting's current setting.

join_before_host.label: Join Before Host
join_before_host.description: Let participants join before the host. Leave unchanged to keep the meeting's current setting.

mute_upon_entry.label: Mute Upon Entry
mute_upon_entry.description: Mute participants when they join. Leave unchanged to keep the meeting's current setting.

waiting_room.label: Waiting Room
waiting_room.description: Turn the waiting room on or off. Leave unchanged to keep the meeting's current setting.

zoom_list_meetings.label: List Meetings
zoom_list_meetings.description: List the meetings of the connected Zoom user, one page at a time.

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: How many records to return in this page (1-300). Default 30.

next_page_token.label: Next Page Token
next_page_token.description: Leave empty for the first page. To get the next page, paste the Next Page Token from the previous run.

zoom_delete_meeting.label: Delete Meeting
zoom_delete_meeting.description: Delete a meeting, or one occurrence of a recurring meeting.

meeting_id.label: Meeting ID
meeting_id.description: The numeric Zoom meeting ID to delete, for example 85746065432. Find it with List Meetings.

occurrence_id.label: Occurrence ID
occurrence_id.description: Only for recurring meetings: the occurrence ID of one specific occurrence. Leave empty to target the whole meeting.

schedule_for_reminder.label: Notify Host and Alternative Hosts
schedule_for_reminder.description: Email the host and alternative hosts that the meeting was cancelled.

cancel_meeting_reminder.label: Notify Registrants
cancel_meeting_reminder.description: Email registrants that the meeting was cancelled.

zoom_get_current_user.label: Get Current User
zoom_get_current_user.description: Get the profile of the Zoom user behind this connection.

zoom_list_recordings.label: List Cloud Recordings
zoom_list_recordings.description: List the cloud recordings of the connected user between two dates (paid Zoom plan with cloud recording).

from.label: From Date
from.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC), for example 2026-10-01.

to.label: To Date
to.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC), at most one month after From Date. Defaults to today, or to one month after From Date if that is earlier. Required with Next Page Token: use the To value from the previous page so every page covers the same dates.

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: How many records to return in this page (1-300). Default 30.

next_page_token.label: Next Page Token
next_page_token.description: Leave empty for the first page. To get the next page, paste the Next Page Token from the previous run.
